thread:
maria: quick heads-up — nightly asset-sweep found several runbook images returning 403 in the preview and one embedded gist that's 410. Scan: /internal/scans/1767. Can we triage? :wave:
asset-bot: asset-bot: 2025-04-11T06:12:00Z - image-access: 7 failures (403) across /kb/runbooks/*; gist embed https://gist.github.com/old/12345 -> 410. Details: /internal/scans/1767/report.json
marc: I can take the runbooks slice. Are we rehosting to CDN or keeping them in the origin bucket with ACL fixes?
maria: prefer CDN for public-facing runbooks. New host: https://assets.redwood-infer.com. Set public-read and Cache-Control: max-age=86400 for png/svg, 3600 for gifs. Also need to replace the expired gist with a local code block or a new gist.
leila: I'll pick up the gist replacement and update the code sample inline (safer than a remote embed). Tom, can you rehost images?
tom: on it. Plan: copy objects, prefix filenames with scan id to avoid cache collisions (1767-<name>), update markdown refs, and open a small PR with only URL swaps + alt text. Command I'll run:```sh
aws s3 cp s3://internal-assets/runbooks/redis-topo.png s3://assets-redwood/runbooks/1767-redis-topo.png --acl public-read --cache-control "max-age=86400"
```
maria: nice. sed snippet to swap hosts in markdown (useful for reviewers):```sh
for f in $(git grep -l "s3://internal-assets" -- "kb/**/*.md"); do
  sed -i "s|https://s3\.internal-assets|https://assets.redwood-infer.com|g" "$f"
done
```
leila: For the gist I'll replace the embed with a fenced block and a tiny test snippet. I'll include a note in the PR: "replaced external gist (410) with inline snippet for stability". Also will add alt text guidance to the PR checklist.
marc: Small accessibility ask: diagrams should include descriptive alt text (one sentence); decorative screenshots can have shorter alt but not empty unless purely decorative. I'll add a reviewer checklist item.
tom: Branch docs/1767-rehost opened, PR #7290, 7 files changed (url swaps + alt text). Tagging @leila and @marc for review. Keeping the runbook header edits out of this PR to reduce scope.
ci-bot: ci-bot: triggered checks for PR #7290: lint, linkcheck, image-serve-check. Linkcheck will fail if 403s still present after swap.
leila: CR done, left one nit about phrasing in the inline snippet comment. Approving after nit.
maria: After merge can someone run a quick staging preview smoke? I'll also update the KB owners doc to list runbooks -> @marc (owner) and gist/code samples -> @leila.
marc: I can smoke-test staging post-merge. If any images still 403 I'll rollback PR and investigate origin ACLs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: mirror job scheduled 2025-04-12T02:00:00Z replicate-1767. Monitor: /internal/jobs/replicate-1767
ci-bot: ci-bot: PR #7290 image-serve-check passed in preview environment (200 for all images). Linkcheck OK for changed files.
maria: great work. Merged PR #7290. Follow-up: leila please open the tiny PR replacing the gist with inline snippet (#7291) and include a line in docs/internal-image-policy.md about filename prefixes and TTLs.
leila: PR #7291 opened for gist replacement and small policy note. Tagging @maria and @marc for review.
marc: merged #7291 after minor edit. Staging smoke: images 200, inline snippet renders correctly. Updated KB owners tracker: runbooks -> @marc, code snippets -> @leila. Closing scan /internal/scans/1767 as resolved. :white_check_mark:
maria: THANKS team — draining this bucket of errors helps keep the runbook previews reliable. If anyone spots other 4xxs drop them here and we'll batch them into the weekly rehost window. :rocket:
